children: On November 22, Strategy founder Michael Saylor posted another Bitcoin Tracker update with the caption, “These dots are not connected yet.”

According to Odaily, orange dots on the Tracker have represented Strategy’s Bitcoin purchases in the past, and the post may indicate the company plans to buy more BTC. Strategy usually discloses changes to its Bitcoin holdings the day after Saylor posts similar updates.

title: Michael Saylor Posts Bitcoin Tracker Again, Potentially Hinting at Further BTC Purchases
